purpose: Freeze metadata-free JPEG, WebP, resize-and-restore, and screenshot-raster variants for offline candidate robustness evaluation. Materialization does not load detectors, read labels for a decision, select thresholds, change product dependencies, or alter web/origin policy.

source_manifest.source_cluster_rule: All derived records retain their source asset SHA-256 and must remain in the same evaluation split as that source.

output_policy.metadata: All artifacts must decode as RGB and contain no EXIF, ICC profile, or XMP payload.
output_policy.overwrite: forbidden; a later rerun requires a new protocol/version or a separately archived failed attempt
